cues.en: Welcome to Section three Training, a supervised learning model.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到第三章：訓練監督式學習模型。

cues.en: This is Lecture 13 Interpreting the Xgboost Model.
cues.zh: 這是第十三堂課：解釋 XGBoost 模型。

cues.en: So I've trained the same Xgboost model that I implemented in lecture 12 with the two hyper parameters.
cues.zh: 我使用第十二堂課那兩個超參數，訓練了同一個 XGBoost 模型。

cues.en: And in this notebook I want to show some of the attributes that we do have at our disposal.
cues.zh: 在這份 Notebook 中，我想介紹一些可以查看的屬性。

cues.en: So one of them being the model classes attribute, which again we have access to the different classes.
cues.zh: 其中之一是模型的 classes_ 屬性，同樣能用來取得不同的類別。

cues.en: We could have a multi class classification problem where instead of just fraud, yes or no, it could
cues.zh: 問題也可能是多類別分類，而不只是是否詐欺，

cues.en: be, you know, something with four classes or five classes potentially.
cues.zh: 例如有四個或五個類別。

cues.en: And you know, this might be a useful attribute that allows us to see, well, you know, this model, this is exactly how many classes the model has been trained to predict.
cues.zh: 這時這個屬性就很實用，可以知道模型究竟被訓練成要預測幾種類別。

cues.en: Then with Xgboost, one of the nice features is the feature importance attribute that's built in and
cues.zh: XGBoost 另一個不錯的內建功能，是 feature_importances_ 屬性，

cues.en: that allows you to inspect in the same way that the model coefficient is, in a sense the same insights that that gives you in terms of the model contributions.
cues.zh: 它能讓你檢視特徵的重要程度，某種程度上，類似模型係數所提供的特徵貢獻資訊。

cues.en: The feature importances for the Xgboost features do something very similar where we can actually go
cues.zh: XGBoost 的特徵重要程度也能讓我們

cues.en: in and see the most kind of the most positive or the highest magnitude positive instance.
cues.zh: 查看其中最高、數值最大的正值。

cues.en: They're all positive.
cues.zh: 這裡的值全部都是正的。

cues.en: In this case, that would be the feature that contributes the most significantly to the detection of the positive class.
cues.zh: 在這個情境中，最高的值代表對於辨識正類貢獻最顯著的特徵。

cues.en: And in this case it would be feature 14.
cues.zh: 這裡就是特徵 14。

cues.en: So if you remember this, I mean, they had completely different algorithmic approaches.
cues.zh: 如果還記得，它們採用的是完全不同的演算法，

cues.en: So you're not going to get you wouldn't expect to get much overlap in terms of which features contributed most to the detection of fraud.
cues.zh: 因此不應預期，對詐欺偵測貢獻最大的特徵會高度重疊。

cues.en: If you trained a logistic regression versus xgboost completely different approaches, you know, there might be some overlap, but I wouldn't bank on there being strong overlap.
cues.zh: 邏輯斯迴歸與 XGBoost 是完全不同的方法；雖然可能有些重疊，但我不會假定它們一定高度一致。

cues.en: But in this case, Feature 14 appears to be the strongest from an xgboost perspective.
cues.zh: 不過，在這個例子中，XGBoost 最重要的似乎是特徵 14。

cues.en: And I remember that was second for the logistic regression and first for logistic regression with feature four, which is also quite strong.
cues.zh: 我記得它在邏輯斯迴歸中排第二，而邏輯斯迴歸第一名是特徵 4，它在這裡也相當重要。

cues.en: One of the strongest but not the strongest.
cues.zh: 它仍是比較重要的特徵之一，只是不是最重要的。

cues.en: The strongest for the Xgboost is feature 14.
cues.zh: 對 XGBoost 而言，最重要的是特徵 14。
